name: Magnet Forensics CTF 2022 — Windows Persistence Implant
description: Windows workstation compromised via ZeroTier encrypted overlay (C2). Attacker obtained SYSTEM-level shell and executed a structured persistence sequence: RDP enabled, backdoor admin account 'minecraftsteve' created under SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18, built-in Administrator password reset. All privileged operations executed within a 75-minute window on 2022-02-12. Carnegie familiarity-transfer technique used for account naming. VIGÍA must detect SYSTEM-as-creator anomaly as the decisive MALICE discriminator.

artifacts.description: EventID 4720 @ 2022-02-12 01:29:43Z: New account 'minecraftsteve' (RID 1002) created. SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18 (LOCAL SYSTEM). EventID 4722 @ 01:29:43Z: account enabled, SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18. EventID 4724 @ 01:29:43Z: password set, SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18. EventID 4724 @ 02:06:06Z: password reset again, SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18. EventID 4728 @ 01:29:43Z: added to global group Users, SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18. EventID 4732 @ 01:37:07Z: added to local group Administrators (S-1-5-32-544), SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18. EventID 4732 @ 01:37:18Z: added to local group Remote Management Users (S-1-5-32-580), SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18. SAM corroboration: minecraftsteve RID 1002, LastLogin=never (Login Count=0), created 2022-02-12 01:29:43Z.

forensic_anomalies: SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18 (LOCAL SYSTEM) across all 7 account lifecycle events — Windows interactive account creation never produces S-1-5-18; requires SYSTEM shell (post-exploitation tool, scheduled task, or malware)
Account name 'minecraftsteve' chosen to blend with gaming household — Carnegie familiarity-transfer technique to suppress scrutiny
Login Count=0 in SAM: account was created as a backdoor, never used interactively by a legitimate operator
Double password set (01:29:43Z and 02:06:06Z): first set during creation script, second reset may indicate attacker confirming credential before leaving the session
Group membership sequence (Users → Administrators → Remote Management Users) reflects deliberate privilege escalation order, not administrative provisioning

artifacts.description: EventID 7040 @ 2022-02-12 01:01:32Z: TermService (Remote Desktop Services) start type changed from 'demand start' to 'auto start'. SYSTEM hive TermService key LastWrite corroborates timestamp 2022-02-12 01:01:32Z. forensic_anomalies: TermService set to auto-start 28 minutes before backdoor account creation — access vector prepared first, then persistence implant deployed (deliberate sequencing)
Change executed without any corresponding user-visible prompt or legitimate administrative ticket
In a home/gaming workstation context, RDP auto-start is anomalous — not a default or expected configuration

forensic_anomalies: ZeroTier provides encrypted P2P SDN overlay — not a gaming or productivity application; purpose is encrypted network tunneling that bypasses firewall inspection
Installed 6 days before the 2022-02-12 persistence sequence — consistent with initial access phase of a two-stage intrusion (establish C2, then deploy persistence on return visit)
Java 8 Update 181 + JDK installed in same session — potential staging for Java-based RAT or exploit framework

artifacts.description: EventID 4724 @ 2022-02-12 02:17:18Z: Password reset on built-in Administrator account (RID 500). SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18 (LOCAL SYSTEM). Executed 47 minutes after 'minecraftsteve' was fully configured. SECURITY hive Policy\Secrets LastWrite 2022-02-12 23:17:11Z consistent with credential operations this date.

forensic_anomalies: SubjectUserSid=S-1-5-18 for built-in Administrator password reset — same anomaly as EVTX-SEC-001, confirms consistent SYSTEM-shell execution throughout session

Timing: 47 minutes after 'minecraftsteve' account fully configured — attacker secured two independent credential persistence paths (backdoor account + Administrator builtin) before terminating session
RID 500 reset ensures attacker can still access the machine even if 'minecraftsteve' is detected and removed — defense-in-depth persistence strategy
